# apipbx_time_group (Resource)

A set of time ranges. Import with "<tenant id>/<time group id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `ranges` (Attributes List) The group matches when any range does. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ranges))
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `timezone` (String) IANA name such as Europe/London; daylight saving is followed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ranges`

Required:

- `end` (String) HH:MM, exclusive; 24:00 is the end of the day. An end before the start runs over midnight and belongs to the days it starts on.
- `start` (String) HH:MM, inclusive.

Optional:

- `month_days` (List of Number) 1-31; empty means every day of the month.
- `months` (List of Number) 1-12; empty means every month.
- `weekdays` (List of String) sun, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat; empty means every day.
